TCGA-BRCA tumor vs normal differential expression

Differential expression and GO enrichment on 25 matched tumor/normal pairs, computed with pydeseq2 and gseapy.

code on GitHub · README

Volcano plot, all tested genes

pydeseq2, paired design ~patient + condition, 25 matched tumor/normal pairs. Significant at padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1: 3,024 up and 5,309 down in tumor. Hover for gene names.

GO Biological Process enrichment

Enrichr GO_Biological_Process_2023 on the up and down gene sets. The up set is dominated by cell-cycle terms, the down set by adhesion and GPCR signaling.

PCA, tumor vs normal

PC1/PC2 of log2(CPM+1) over filtered genes. Pairs of dots from the same patient are connected.

Every number on this page comes from the result files committed in the repository. Built as a static page, no server.
